title: Tweezer Rescue
shareTitle: Tweezer Rescue 🫳 — Pincer Grip Rescue Play
description: Pick up little clay friends with big clay tweezers and carry them home: ladybugs to flowers, bees to the honeycomb, goldfish to pools, pom-poms to nests. A gentle fine-motor game for ages 5–6.
learningGoals: Practice a controlled pincer grip through press-and-hold squeeze, carry, and release
Listen for and match spoken color, size, and counting vocabulary
Build steady hand-eye coordination with forgiving, retry-friendly drops
interactionModel: custom two-arm pivoting tweezer tool: pointerdown squeezes and grabs a nearby critter, drag carries it with a velocity-driven pendulum wobble, release drops it on a target; two-finger pinch maps to arm opening as an enhancement
feedbackModel: A correct drop arcs in, bounces, pops and sparkles with spoken color/size/count praise; a miss or wrong target floats the critter gently back with a soft boing and a warm nudge — never a failure sound, retry is free.
credits: Kaigani; claymation production art and teacher-voice narration produced with local Qwen/Krea GenAI workflows and Whisper QA (see ASSETS.md). Built with Claude Code for QLOBE Kids.
